entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer that supports multi-level states for users, sessions, and agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine provides sub-300ms recall for high-volume workloads and features a custom vector graph engine with byte-level deduplication. It supports automated fact extraction across platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub using multi-modal extractors for various file types.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that uses a filesystem management paradigm to unify agent memories and skills. It utilizes tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token consumption and provides visualized retrieval trajectories for transparent context management.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain uses a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges to provide synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It is designed for flexible deployment, supporting both local PGLite and remote server configurations.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight is a learning memory system that implements long-term workflows for retaining, recalling, and reflecting on information. It offers Python and Node.js SDKs alongside Docker-based deployment options for integrating persistent memory into agentic workflows.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library enables stateful agents through peer-centric modeling and background reasoning, serving as the upstream foundation for self-hosted Hermes wrappers. It is available as a managed service or a FastAPI server with support for Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Byterover-cli manages context as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a plain markdown context tree. It provides 5-tier retrieval with sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency, SQLite-backed memory system designed for sub-millisecond performance without external service requirements. It includes a TripleStore for temporal knowledge graph management and is compatible with MCP clients and Python agents.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive context harness improves agent performance by generating persistent playbooks and hints from iterative task runs. It distills successful behaviors into local-model training artifacts and exports CLI-first skills specifically formatted for Hermes integration.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin uses a DAG-based engine and a SQLite message store to ensure no agent messages are lost. It provides specialized tools for searching and expanding compacted material while supporting optional redaction of sensitive patterns.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted Honcho backend for Hermes Agent, enabling private cross-session persistence via Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It is compatible with any OpenAI-style LLM provider or local inference server for complete data sovereignty.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur implements a shared memory layer using an open engram YAML format for multi-agent systems, storing knowledge as plain-text files on disk. It supports hierarchical scoping for global or project-specific knowledge and integrates with tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signetai provides local-first custody of identity, secrets, and memory, ensuring portable state across various agent harnesses and MCP clients. It features a dedicated dashboard that allows users to inspect and repair stored memory manually.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates without cloud dependencies or API keys by using a shared SQLite vault. It utilizes hybrid retrieval combining vector search with multi-graph traversal to synchronize memory across different runtimes.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This plugin optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to maximize prefix reuse and reduce prefill latency by up to 3x. It is designed to save tokens and accelerate inference for Hermes Agent and the broader OpenClaw ecosystem.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a local-first, file-based system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family that includes an MCP server, a CLI, and a dedicated Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recall with a reason why it was retrieved. It tracks contradictions using conflict resolution primitives and includes a built-in outcome ledger for recording agent-authored skills.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single stack using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma. It is designed to provide agents with a purpose-built evidence packet for every query to improve retrieval accuracy.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and uses SQLite-vec for local-first storage. It operates as an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory system that combines BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal for semantic discovery. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select only the most relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent native tool search.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, aiming to reduce prompt tokens by up to 94%. It uses a specific scaffolding structure to render context for project files like AGENTS.md.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as a local source of truth, storing long-term memory as canonical Markdown files with wikilink support. It is a daemonless system that utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable cache for BM25 and semantic retrieval.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a columnar embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via a 1-10 importance ranking system. It supports BM25 keyword search and optional entity extraction to establish named relationships between entries.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin uses a pull-model that supports real deletion of events to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It provides an audit trace of all memory operations via a trace.jsonl log for transparency.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory with semantic search and provenance tracking for Hermes Agent. It features automatic memory mirroring from native tools and supports session snapshots with TTL-based state storage.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail is an SDK and MCP server that enables AI agents to handle payments and charge for API usage across multiple blockchain families like EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes and other agent frameworks to provide a financial layer for autonomous operations.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory, providing tools for both manual storage and automated searching. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize retrieval quality.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, enabling semantic search and grounded Q&A across CLI and desktop interfaces. It requires a local SourceVault server to maintain the privacy and security of the codebase.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield offers a suite of 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using hybrid search methods. It features automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve essential information.

entries.obra/superpowers: An agentic skills framework and software development methodology utilizing a subagent-driven-development process. It includes skills for brainstorming and planning while emphasizing red/green TDD and YAGNI.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first open-source design and prototyping system that supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports. It features coding-agent CLI support and is compatible with various coding agents and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A collection of 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills mapped to six major frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. These skills cover 29 security domains and are compatible with 26+ AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: A tool for generating draw.io diagrams from natural language descriptions using 11 diagram type presets. It converts Mermaid text into editable files and includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing and rewriting tool designed to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns. It uses a two-pass detection system and a 111-entry word replacement table to support agents like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: A system for collective skill evolution that provides automated deduplication and quality improvement. It enables unified skill libraries across multiple agents and shared user teams.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform skills library compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents. It contains 50 expert frameworks and 12 metaskills designed to orchestrate business and code journeys.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: A trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce providing adjudication for deals. It includes natural-language mandates, escrow, dispute resolution, and various payment protocols.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation for detected patterns.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI through filesystem-based or programmatic Python definitions. It uses progressive disclosure of skill metadata to reduce token usage.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A suite of skills for extracting YouTube transcripts, captions, and timestamps without using yt-dlp. It supports video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for various AI agents.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: A skill set that enables the dynamic generation of custom analytical lenses via /prism-scan. It includes seven pre-built prisms and a /prism-reflect command for identifying analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A workflow skill that converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes alongside a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running AI agents that provides structured memory and a three-level work model. It supports file-backed and SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for task management.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: A literate programming skill that weaves code and documentation into.lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A plugin for self-memory and replacement models that uses markdown files for cross-instance shared memory. It automates the capture of high-value decisions to facilitate fine-tuning replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: An implementation of the agentskills.io specification for interacting with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds integration.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Official image generation skills for the FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It provides standardized prompting guidelines, JSON structured prompting, and API integration patterns.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: A tool that converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides provenance via file:line citations or documentation URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It includes a Python SkilldockClient, a CLI, and commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: A skill for autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks. It provides real-time progress tracking and built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It uses a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental metadata discovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: A skill for managing Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: A workflow language for AI implemented as a single Rust binary under the AGPL-3.0 license. It features static auditing for cost, secrets, and types, and provides hash-chained execution receipts.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer intelligent skill retrieval system that uses hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model family and tracks quality scores in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial code review skill that uses three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases and exploitability. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec for deterministic pre-scanning.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io with MCP integration. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automatic registration of common skill directories.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: A skill that implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine for state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent code simplification skill using a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It includes a risk-tiered triage system for safe code modifications.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing, searching, and one-click installation of skills. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification and features federated search integration.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: A CLI and MCP server that allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: A skill that automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: A multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator that produces structured reports from global to street level. It includes quality gates, AI analysis, and semantic memory for user interests.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, with support for both binary and source-based installations. It features daily automated updates for all included packages and includes agents from providers such as Google and OpenAI.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It provides an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw using Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This is a zero-install Windows desktop agent that requires no admin rights and operates without Docker. It features a GUI, an integrated workflow engine for automated multi-step pipelines, and an extensive toolset including TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It supports direct deployment or operator-ready CRD-based workflows and offers a configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for Hermes Agent sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies regarding messaging and web search.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration of workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is designed to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps, and includes a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities and workspaces through a single web application. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access for external AI client integrations.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project enables production-ready, headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers by configuring Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It supports the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework decomposes financial trading tasks into specialized analyst and researcher roles for research purposes. It includes dedicated agents for risk management and portfolio management to handle complex market analysis workflows.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables task dispatching and multi-agent workflows with integrated cost tracking and quality review gates. It connects to agents via REST API, WebSocket, or MCP servers and supports deployment through Node.js or Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and mobile-friendly web dashboard for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It ensures agent isolation by utilizing git worktrees and Docker sandboxing during session management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to orchestrated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, registry management, and automated VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent, this level-based architecture utilizes a task bus for delegation and handoffs between orchestrators and specialists. It features pre-configured skills for VPS provisioning, backup management, and security auditing.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool allows users to build autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual organization charts to help users manage and delegate tasks within agent teams.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous task status and human-in-the-loop verification for task completions. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution to allow for direct supervision of Hermes Agent work.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized AI agents through a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator. The agents are divided into specific roles covering research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via a Hermes Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This project creates an agent-vs-agent arena where two competing AI companies, powered by Hermes Agent and Paperclip, vie for GitHub stars. A real-time dashboard visualizes the tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics for the nine autonomous agents involved.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This skill implements ACP-style delegation to route tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It includes an auto-syncing index and an MCP server compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A native Rust CLI tool designed for high-performance local monitoring of token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents. It features a TUI and supports integrations with Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect system prompts, tool calls, and streaming responses from coding-agent API traffic. It enables the comparison of adjacent requests to debug agent behavior and exports portable HTML trace artifacts.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better user interfaces with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other markdown-supporting providers to deliver structured UI assistance.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills for building and operating applications. It supports autonomous execution on both local laptops and remote VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A community-driven project that provides YAML-based CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art with styles ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This project establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable @handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring separate processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a visible UI for real-time human supervision. It includes an integrated research desk and session management to support external agent tools.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configurations, local memories, and project-specific skills. It allows users to switch seamlessly between default and scoped agents based on the local directory.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes pre-configured with over 40 skills for finance, DevOps, and research across macOS and Linux.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: A deployment tool that automates the installation of a full Hermes Agent stack and 12 supporting services in minutes. It offers three scalable tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories at zero cost.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A static linter that uses seven structural detectors to scan agent configurations and system prompts for common failure modes without making LLM calls. It provides deterministic, fast scoring for JSON, YAML, and .prompt files.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility maps OpenClaw configurations, credentials, and memory archives into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles the transition of SOUL.md and skills while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: A self-healing observability tool that monitors multi-agent systems for operational health and functional drift without cloud dependencies. Its Hermes plugin exports telemetry for API requests and tracks token intelligence to manage memory bloat.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users. It allows for the simultaneous management of Hermes Agent alongside other AI agents and CLI tools in a single application.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that unifies multiple CLI agents into one interface with a zero-configuration built-in engine. It distinguishes itself by automating the creation of office documents, including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel files.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web-based interface offers full parity with the Hermes CLI experience for both desktop and mobile browsers. It features a three-panel layout for workspace file browsing and utilizes SSH tunneling to provide secure remote access.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to simplify the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: This dashboard focuses on multi-platform connectivity, offering unified configuration for channels like Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It includes a file browser and web terminal while providing usage analytics and profile-scoped file management via local SQLite storage.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a 'Swarm Mode' with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task handling. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and dedicated managers for skills, memory, and MCP catalogs.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for real-time session data. It includes specialized native views for Kanban boards, cron jobs, and an embedded terminal for system repair and shell access.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension integrates Hermes Agent directly into the browser context for Chrome and Edge users. It can connect to local runtimes, Hermes Cloud, or remote gateways to provide a full-page web workspace.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime. It is specifically designed to support LaTeX and Markdown rendering for enhanced document visualization.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted dashboard features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines in real-time. It provides a control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and visualizes tool calls during streaming chat sessions.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit that tracks per-session quota burn-rates and costs across Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It allows users to inspect transcripts and browse images generated during agent sessions.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This macOS workspace is tailored for Orgo cloud computers and SSH hosts, offering one-click automated installation on fresh cloud VMs. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode that utilizes OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this terminal-based dashboard consolidates Hermes chat, sessions, and configuration into a TUI. It includes integrated kanban boards for diagnostics and an extensible Eikon avatar system for lifecycle management.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram, supporting dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication. It enables background agent spawning with support for up to five concurrent instances and streaming terminal chat.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This no-install Windows application requires no admin rights or Docker to run Hermes Agent locally via LM Studio. It includes a workflow engine for multi-step automation and 100 built-in tools for tasks like TTS and ComfyUI.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This self-hosted assistant features a glassmorphic web interface with real-time log streaming and task tracking. It provides management tools specifically for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A specialized monitoring dashboard that provides read-only inspection of environment variables and configuration. It allows users to track session costs in real-time and inspect the source code of active skills and conversation histories.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace uses isolated profiles to manage separate sessions, memory, and API keys. It features a chat-first design with tool approval cards and an integrated marketplace for discovering new skills and MCP servers.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents for complex tasks. It includes a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
